en: The Extensive Record of Chan Master Yunmen Kuangzhen, Volume One, with Preface.

Preface to the Extensive Record of Chan Master Yunmen Kuangzhen: For several hundred years, the ancestral lamp has been passed down in succession. Among them, there have appeared those who transcend their peers and surpass their kind, excelling both the present and the past.
Exhausting the subtle and exhausting the divine, there have been only a few individuals whose Way has flourished throughout the world;
the Great Master Yunmen was preeminent among them.
He could seize and release, expand and contract, moving with mastery in all directions through infinite transformations.
Releasing the rivers and seas,
fish and dragons find the way to swim; grasping the heavens and earth,
they are brought to a halt.
The ghosts and spirits have no path upon which to walk;
even the grasses and trees must bow their heads,
and the earth and stones emit light for them.

As for those [records] transmitted to the world: the *Duiji shilu* (Record of the Chamber for Responding to Capacities) has been subject to cross-examination and verification over successive generations;
as for the *Xinglu* (Record of Conduct), due to the long passage of time, there may be some discrepancies and errors.
Now, having consulted various editions, this has been revised and newly carved into printing blocks so that it may circulate forever,

Were one to establish separate lineages and distinct schools,
it would inevitably mean compounding error upon error.
To record merits and commemorate virtues is already to bury former sages;
to draw patterns and follow models is merely to imitate.
This would merely serve to confuse later students.
If one possesses the eye at the crown of the head, where could one meet Yunmen?
